title: JAP writer import, contract 1 (make writer-import FILE=...)
description: One object keyed by application_id, each holding an answer for every open question of that job (all at once), plus resume:<resume_id> for each resume read. Placeholders are filled back in by JAP. PRD 1.22 W6, 1.28 W12. A job may also hold "_review": "<reason>" (PRD 1.29 V6): JAP keeps its answers but holds it at Ready for review and never sends it on its own.
